item.title: Timepieces Thursdays: 2003 Timex Indiglo WR 30M “Ford Philippines Commemorative Watch”
item.description: Timex’s Indiglo watch series, with their electroluminescent backlight technology, has been around for more than 34 years. Timex received the patent for the backlight technology in October 1988 and integrated the Indiglo backlight technology into its popular Ironman Triathlon quartz watches in 1992.
